# Zebkit agent context

Zebkit is a token-driven, accessibility-first web component library. Components have one semantic grammar; utility classes are exhaustive, token-bound CSS vocabulary.

## Verify your work

After generating or editing markup, run `npx zebkit check --format=json` and fix what it reports.
It validates your markup against this library's grammar AND this project's compiled CSS, so it
catches things no general linter can: a utility behind a breakpoint this project disabled, a
variant that is not registered, a token the build excluded. Every finding names its own fix.

## Components

- [zbk-button](zbk-button.md): A light-DOM element wrapping a real <button>: renders the token-driven skeleton, forwards native semantics, adds opt-in loading, and governs retained content through visibility composites.
- [zbk-code-block](zbk-code-block.md): A labelled source listing that preserves authored code, supplies copying, and can expose a trusted rendered preview through two-way tabs and an independently controlled resizable Split layout.
- [zbk-heading](zbk-heading.md): The zbk-heading component.
- [zbk-link](zbk-link.md): A light-DOM element wrapping a real <a>: forwards native anchor semantics, adopts authored content into a token-driven skeleton, and can borrow button's style contract via appearance="button" without ever becoming a button.
- [zbk-tabs](zbk-tabs.md): A labelled set of mutually exclusive retained panels with native tab buttons, roving focus, automatic or manual activation, logical placement, and overflow-safe keyboard navigation.
- [zbk-toggle](zbk-toggle.md): An on/off switch that takes effect immediately: a light-DOM element wrapping a real <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> inside its own label — the APG switch pattern on a fully native input, drawn as a track with a traveling thumb.

## Composite attributes

- [Visibility composites](composites.md): `toggles` / `shows` / `hides`, target mechanisms, late resolution, events, and focus.

## Utilities

- [Layout utilities](utilities-layout.md): flex, display, positioning, object fitting, overflow, and visibility.
- [Grid utilities](utilities-grid.md): grid tracks, placement, alignment, and sizing.
- [Spacing utilities](utilities-spacing.md): margins, padding, sizes, position offsets, and page or section rhythm.
- [Typography utilities](utilities-typography.md): type scales, text behavior, and long-form prose.
- [Border utilities](utilities-borders.md): border width, radius, style, and semantic border color.
- [Effects utilities](utilities-effects.md): elevation, opacity, stacking order, transitions, and focus rings.
- [Interaction utilities](utilities-interaction.md): cursor and pointer-event behavior.
- [Color utilities](utilities-color.md): token-bound ink, canvas, border, fill, and interaction-state color surfaces.
